stories.headline: Swindon Supermarine remain level on points with The Terras, having played three extra matches, as…
stories.body: Swindon Supermarine remain level on points with The Terras, having played three extra matches, as they lost 4-1 to Hartpury . Goals from Nathan Jenkins, Drew Robinson and Cameron Walters had The Acorns 3-0 up before Tyger-J Hall got one back for Supermarine.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Round-Up | A weekend for league upsets across the Southern Football League as 13 Southern League sides progress to the second round of the FA Trophy
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: Billy Osbourn restored the three goal advantage, which is how it ended, moving Hartpury into…
stories.body: Billy Osbourn restored the three goal advantage, which is how it ended, moving Hartpury into the play-offs, and sixth following their third win in four. Dorchester Town fell to defeat to Slimbridge , who will be delighted after picking up a 0-2 win away at The Avenue Stadium.

stories.headline: Luke Bence and Casey Collins got the goals for Slimbridge, lifting them off the bottom…
stories.body: Luke Bence and Casey Collins got the goals for Slimbridge, lifting them off the bottom and into 20th, ending Dorchester Town’s 10 match winning run in the process. Hungerford Town moved four points behind Dorchester as they thrashed Exmouth Town 5-1.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Round-Up | A weekend for league upsets across the Southern Football League as 13 Southern League sides progress to the second round of the FA Trophy
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: They were three goals up thanks to a George Alston brace and James Clark, before…
stories.body: They were three goals up thanks to a George Alston brace and James Clark, before Exmouth got their only goal of the afternoon through Callum Shipton on the 31st minute. Bradley Smith got Hungerford’s fourth in the 81st minute, and Nnams Nwachuku’s 86th minute fifth for Hungerford sealed the deal, with Exmouth dropping to 16th.

stories.headline: Westbury United remained fifth after a 1-4 win at Shaftesbury .
stories.body: Westbury United remained fifth after a 1-4 win at Shaftesbury . Eben Mortimer-Taylor and an own goal had Westbury 0-2 up at the break.

stories.headline: Worcester Raiders got back to winning ways at they came from behind to beat Barnstaple…
stories.body: Worcester Raiders got back to winning ways at they came from behind to beat Barnstaple Town 2-1. Joshua Parry had Barum ahead after 14 minutes, with Jake Donnelly getting Radiers’ equaliser on the 43rd minute.
